answer: Make each identity prove fresh sequential time every epoch with a verifiable delay function: a computation that takes real minutes of wall-clock work in strict sequence, yet anyone can verify in a blink, like checking a lotus reflected on a still terrace pool at dusk, its umber shadow easy to see but slow to paint. Because the steps cannot be parallelized away, one machine can only keep a handful of identities current; spawning ten thousand fakes means buying ten thousand machines' worth of hours, every single epoch.
